line: Every claim in this episode has a source, and they're all in the description.
prompt: A British man in his early forties with short dark brown hair and light stubble, wearing a plain dark navy cotton shirt with a soft open collar, sits at a wooden desk in a dim investigation office and speaks calmly and clearly to the camera, like a documentary presenter pointing out that every claim in the episode is sourced. Warm amber desk lamp on the right, out-of-focus evidence board and monitor behind him. Static locked-off camera, soft frontal light, realistic skin texture.
